_comment: ACTRIIA (ACVR2A / AVRA2A) re-seeding ablation. Prior blind run seed_search_AVRA2A completed the folding prefilter for most conditions but was PyRosetta-scored for only 4 -> just 1 PyRosetta-passing founder. With founder_filter_stage=auto the loader auto-supplements from the ~82 folding-passing conditions, so it runs immediately (founders = folding-passing complexes). For STRICT PyRosetta founders instead, run pipeline.reseed.prepare_founders (see README), then set baseline_run_dir to its output and founder_filter_stage='pyrosetta'. target_len verified = chain A of AVR2A.pdb.
